Full narrative

A SIMPLE METHOD FOR THE ISOLATION AND PURIFICATION OF TOTAL LIPIDES FROM ANIMAL TISSUES (1957) in Journal of Biological Chemistry is authored by Jordi Folch, Marjorie B. Lees and G H S Stanley. Topics: Isolation (microbiology), Simple (philosophy), Chemistry, Chromatography and Biology.

65279 citations (OpenAlex). Citations peaked in 2020 with 2024 citing works. Citing venues include Lipids, Journal of Lipid Research and Aquaculture.
